name: Death's Slumber Ward
description: A whirlwind of four ephemeral, magical threads dispels the undead and shrouds the living in an endless slumber.
disable:
DC 23 Religion (expert) or DC 21 Performance (trained) to dissipate one of the four threads. Characters who failed or critically failed a Performance check to participate in Grandfather Eiwa's funeral in Chapter 1 have been able to reflect on the experience; these characters gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their Performance checks to disable this trap.

The trap is destroyed when all four threads are dissipated.
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after no living or undead creatures are within 100 feet, then resets.
routine: (4 actions) Each thread of energy passes through a random living or undead creature within 60 feet, dealing 4d6 damage (Basic DC 22 Will Saving Throw) to the creature. A thread deals 4d6 Void Damage damage to living creatures and 4d6 Vitality Damage damage to undead creatures. Each thread passes through a different random creature, if possible. Each dissipated thread reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.

generalAbilities.name: Breath of Pharasma
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living or undead creature opens the trunk

Effect The ephemeral winds rise, sapping energy. All living and undead creatures within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Slowed 1 (Slowed 2 on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.
